mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_component WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND enabled = 1
SELECT type, total FROM () x WHERE total > 0 ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT c.system_code, COALESCE(s.short_name, s.name, c.system_code) AS system_name, COALESCE(agg.cnt, 0) AS asset_count FROM dm_component c LEFT JOIN arch_physical_subsystem s ON s.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND s.code = c.system_code AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT system_code, tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM () u WHERE system_code IS NOT NULL AND system_code <> '' GROUP BY system_code, tenant_id) agg ON agg.system_code = c.system_code AND agg.tenant_id = c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.enabled = 1 AND c.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY c.system_code, s.short_name, s.name ORDER BY system_name
